title: Fallout 3 — Primary ESM Memory-Chip / Pinkerton Carrier-Class Audit v2.8

pinkerton_terminal.significance: The three Pinkerton NOTE records are explicitly presented as terminal log entries.

pinkerton_log_2.primary_text_summary: Pinkerton says he stole a memory chip from Braun; Braun was absorbed in his simulation; Pinkerton states he cannot know whose memories are contained in the chip until integrating it into a new host.

pinkerton_log_3.primary_text_summary: Pinkerton states that he put the memory into the android; the android now calls himself Harkness, believes he is a veteran, and woke disoriented after the procedure.

pinkerton_log_1.summary: Pinkerton says he built a circuit neuralizer from scrap using diagrams acquired from the Vault.

neuralizer_records.summary: Primary NOTE/INFO text repeatedly describes a circuit neuralizer used to erase/replace android memory, but no separately identifiable MISC/ACTI/REFR physical neuralizer object record was found in the reviewed ESM search.

important_correction.old_risk: Treating MS08PinkertonLog2 itself as the stolen physical memory-chip object because its FULL title is 'Чип памяти'.
important_correction.primary_esm_result: PinkertonTerminal explicitly labels 00024D63 as Android Log Entry 2 alongside Log Entries 1 and 3; therefore NOTE 00024D63 is best treated as the terminal narrative record about the chip, not proof that the NOTE record is the technical carrier object itself.

next_gate.name: BRAUN_VAULT112_MEMORY_CHIP_SOURCE_PATH_AND_TEMPORAL_BINDING_AUDIT_v2.9
targets: Resolve every primary ESM Braun/Vault112 record that can constrain how a prepopulated memory chip came to exist before Pinkerton stole it.
Separate automatic system persistence, Braun manual operation, archived donor state and unsupported one-chip-per-lounger models.
Use chronology: Pinkerton theft in 2276 cannot contain James's later 2277 session.
Determine the minimum additional operation required for SAVE JAMES in 2277: new carrier, rewritten carrier, or another system persistence artifact.
Keep exact donor of Pinkerton's stolen chip UNKNOWN unless primary source binding appears.
